import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
y = train["target"]
train = train.drop(["target"], axis=1)

# Identify column types
cat_cols = [col for col in train.columns if train[col].dtype == "object"]
int_cols = [col for col in train.columns if train[col].dtype == "int64" and col != "id"]
float_cols = [col for col in train.columns if train[col].dtype == "float64"]

# Process categorical features
# High-cardinality string feature f_27
le = LabelEncoder()
train["f_27_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train["f_27"])
test["f_27_encoded"] = le.transform(test["f_27"])

# Other categorical integer features (f_29, f_30) - treat as categorical
cat_cols = ["f_27_encoded", "f_29", "f_30"]

# Feature engineering: create interaction features for continuous columns
# Simple but effective: product and sum of selected features
for col1, col2 in [("f_00", "f_01"), ("f_19", "f_20"), ("f_28", "f_21")]:
    train[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = train[col1] * train[col2]
    test[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = test[col1] * test[col2]
    train[f"{col1}_+_{col2}"] = train[col1] + train[col2]
    test[f"{col1}_+_{col2}"] = test[col1] + test[col2]

# Combine feature lists
all_features = [col for col in train.columns if col != "id"] + [
    "f_27_encoded",
    "f_00_x_f_01",
    "f_00_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_01"),
]

# Prepare feature matrices
feature_cols = (
    [col for col in train.columns if col != "id" and col not in ["f_27"]]
    + ["f_27_encoded"]
    + [
        f"f_00_x_f_01",
        f"f_00_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_01"),
        f"f_19_x_f_20",
        f"f_19_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_20"),
        f"f_28_x_f_21",
        f"f_28_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_21"),
    ]
)

# Create new feature names list
new_features = [
    "f_00_x_f_01",
    "f_00_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_01"),
    "f_19_x_f_20",
    "f_19_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_20"),
    "f_28_x_f_21",
    "f_28_+_{col2}".replace("{col2}", "f_21"),
]

feature_cols = (
    [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "f_27"]]
    + ["f_27_encoded"]
    + new_features
)

X_train = train[feature_cols]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

# Split for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Predict on validation set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set and create submission
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
submission["target"] = test_pred
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
